item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":2,"rationale":"The President delegates review authority to the OPM Director and then mandates substantive limits the Director must enforce when reviewing proposed pay increases; the legally consequential pay outcome occurs later through the Director's review or disapproval.","evidence":"the Director of the Office of Personnel Management shall assure that any increases in basic pay proposed by the Administrator of Veterans' Affairs are in the best interest of the Federal government; do not exceed the amounts authorized by Section 112; and are made only to:"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The Veterans' Affairs Administrator must furnish requested information to support the Director's delegated responsibilities, an internal administrative duty with no legal consequence for pay occurring in this segment.","evidence":"shall provide to the Director of the Office of Personnel Management such information as the Director may request"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The Director must transmit a copy of a disapproval statement to the Administrator, which is internal administrative communication rather than a provision changing or dictating a legal entitlement or pay rate.","evidence":"The Director shall provide the Administrator of Veterans' Affairs with a copy of any written statement"}]}
